name: <the name you want the driver listed under by get_instruments(), for example stellaris>

connection.microscope: <a name for this particular instrument, for example stellaris5-room-42>
connection.api_type: <how the vendor software is reached, for example socket, grpc or dll>
connection.host: <if the vendor software listens on a network address, put it here>
connection.password: <if the vendor software requires a password or token, put it here>
connection.config: <if the vendor software has a configuration file, put its path here>
